name: Requesty
billing: Free models and paid routing have different limits. Check the selected model’s price, available credits and team/key spend controls before making a request.

regions.name: Your routing region
regions.note: Review Requesty’s routing and data handling settings for your workload. Use the endpoint and model your account is configured to serve.

steps.title: Create or sign in to your account
steps.body: Open the Requesty app through its official quickstart and select your application’s organization.

steps.title: Create an API key
steps.body: Open API Keys, create a separate application key, and keep it only in your own secret storage.

steps.title: Review model and spend settings
steps.body: Choose a currently available model identifier and review credits, model access and applicable spend limits before configuring the router endpoint.
